metinler: If you eat eggs most mornings, here is something worth knowing.
Harvard researchers followed more than 215,000 nurses and other health professionals for up to 32 years.
Those who ate at least one egg a day had no clear extra risk of heart disease or stroke.
For every extra 300 milligrams of dietary cholesterol a day, about one and a half eggs, the risk of heart disease and stroke was 17 percent higher.
